title: Sources including French public officials detail how Mistral's rise over the past three years owes much to the privileged relationship it built with Macron (Océane Herrero/Politico)
summary: Océane Herrero / Politico: Sources including French public officials detail how Mistral's rise over the past three years owes much to the privileged relationship it built with Macron — Mistral has forged unrivaled ties with the French presidency. contentText:
Océane Herrero / Politico :

Sources including French public officials detail how Mistral's rise over the past three years owes much to the privileged relationship it built with Macron   —  Mistral has forged unrivaled ties with the French presidency.  Now, Emmanuel Macron is departing.  —  in Paris
